CA2I.Title: Import from Chummer
CA2I.NotSra2: This world runs {system}, not Shadowrun Anarchy 2 (sra2). Runners can only be imported into an sra2 world.
CA2I.NewerSra2: Tested with sra2 {tested}; this world runs {version}. The import may miss new fields.
CA2I.InWorld: In world: exported {world} · This file: exported {file} ({compare})
CA2I.OlderWarning: This file is older than the copy in your world. Skip is chosen for you.
CA2I.Duplicate: {label}: “{name}” is in this file more than once; the last one was kept.
CA2I.NothingInBook: Nothing in this book to import
CA2I.LeftAlone: Entries not in this file were left as they were.
CA2I.PackTypeClash: A compendium named {id} already holds {type}; delete it or move its contents, then import again.
CA2I.RunnersAndNpcs: {runners} runners · {npcs} NPCs. NPCs go into the Actors folder “Chummer NPCs”.

Icons.Title: Apply icons
Icons.Hint: Point imported items, skills, vehicles and metatypes at the module's icons again, e.g. after a module update adds art.
Icons.Explain: Sets the module's icons on imported items, skills, specializations, vehicles and metatypes in the world, on runners and in the Chummer compendiums. An image you chose yourself is never replaced: only empty images, Foundry's and sra2's stock images, and the module's own icons are. Character portraits and tokens are not touched.
Icons.Done: Updated {updated} · kept {kept} you chose · {unchanged} already right. Entries imported before 0.4.0 carry no icon information: import the runner or book once more to give them icons.
Icons.NoIndex: The module's icon list couldn't be loaded (see the console), so no icons can be applied.
